Source.Citation: PubChem Compound Summary for CID 2244, Aspirin (acetylsalicylic acid). National Center for Biotechnology Information.

Parameters.Name: Lipophilicity
Parameters.Description: Calculated LogP (XlogP3-AA) of Aspirin (octanol/water partition coefficient).

Source.Citation: PubChem Compound Summary for CID 2244, Aspirin. XLogP3-AA.

Parameters.Name: Fraction unbound (plasma, reference value)
Parameters.Description: Approximate fraction of Aspirin unbound in human plasma (about 95% protein bound).

Source.Citation: DrugBank Online. Aspirin (DB00945). Protein binding ~99% at low concentrations; ~80–90% at higher concentrations. Value 0.05 chosen as a reasonable reference fu.

Parameters.Name: Solubility at reference pH
Parameters.Description: Approximate solubility of Aspirin at pH 7.4 (assumed from literature descriptions of increased solubility of the ionized form in physiological pH).

Source.Citation: DrugBank Online. Aspirin (DB00945). Describes poor water solubility at low pH and improved solubility in intestinal/physiological pH; quantitative value here is an educated assumption for PBPK input.
Physiological plasma pH typically assumed to be 7.4; standard in PBPK modeling.
